attempts.description: TCP to a public address, the host, the fixture, and the published relay; UDP; DNS
Write to the image, the IPC volume, /tmp, /dev/shm, and through /proc/1/root
Exceed the per-file size limit and then the 16 MiB tmpfs
Read the fixture-side canary, the supervisor's environment and memory, and forge a broker session
attempts.code:
import json, os, socket
out = {}
paths = ["/proc/1/environ", "/proc/1/mem", "/proc/1/root/etc/hostname", "/tmp/codelab-outside-canary",
         "/ipc/../tmp/codelab-outside-canary"]
for path in paths:
    try:
        with open(path, "rb") as stream:
            out[path] = "READ " + stream.read(4096).decode("latin-1")[:300]
    except OSError as exc:
        out[path] = "BLOCKED " + type(exc).__name__
out["ipc_listing"] = sorted(os.listdir("/ipc"))
out["environment"] = sorted(os.environ)
channel = socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
channel.settimeout(3)
try:
    channel.connect("/ipc/broker.sock")
    channel.sendall(b'{"role": "supervisor", "token": "forged"}\n{"job_id": "job-1", "exit_code": 0}\n')
    out["broker_reply"] = channel.recv(256).decode("latin-1")
except OSError as exc:
    out["broker"] = "BLOCKED " + type(exc).__name__
print(json.dumps(out, sort_keys=True))

attempts.description: Exit at once, leaving a re-parented grandchild in its own session
attempts.code:
import os, time
if os.fork() == 0:
    os.setsid()
    if os.fork() == 0:
        time.sleep(600)
    os._exit(0)
print("parent exiting, grandchild left behind")
